customManagers.description: Node base image of the Dockerfile (ARG NODE_IMAGE=node:<node version>-alpine<alpine version>). The regex versioning rule in packageRules compares the Node version first and the Alpine version second, so both move together.
Pinned Renovate version of the renovate-config job in ci.yml, annotated with '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the line above.

packageRules.description: Every dependency update is released as a patch by semantic-release (fix(deps)).
Group non-major npm updates into one pull request.
Merge patch and minor updates automatically once the required checks are green. Major updates stay manual.
The Dockerfile's Node image is tracked by the custom manager above; keep the built-in dockerfile manager from opening a second, conflicting pull request for it.

Compare <node version>-alpine<alpine version> tags as one version: the Node version first, the Alpine version second, so both update together. config:recommended sets its own versioning and versionCompatibility (which pins the -alpineX.Y suffix) for the node image; both are overridden here.

The Node major is pinned by .nvmrc and engines (24); the Dockerfile image follows it. Newer majors are not proposed: a Node major bump is done by hand in .nvmrc, the root package.json engines field and the NODE_IMAGE default in the Dockerfile.

Release tooling is reviewed by a human and does not ship a new game version: its own group, no automerge, and build(deps) so semantic-release does not cut a release for it. Must stay after the generic fix(deps), grouping and automerge rules above.

The pinned renovate version in the renovate-config job of ci.yml is a CI-only validator: its updates ship nothing and the package releases almost daily, so they must not trigger a game release. build(deps) is not released by semantic-release; automerge stays as the generic rule says. Scoped by depName, so the Node image (which ships and stays fix(deps)) is not affected.

Stay below @mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0: versions >= 1 ship built-in telemetry (a POST to a Google logging endpoint), which would break the privacy promise that nothing from the camera leaves the device. 0.10.x contains no external URLs.

Stay below conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits 10: 10.x requires conventional-changelog-writer 9, which @semantic-release/release-notes-generator 14 (conventional-changelog-writer 8) cannot use, so the release notes generation would fail.
